versions.name: Camp Otter Run
versions.summary: A primitive Simon Kenton Council camp north of Marysville near East Liberty, Ohio, on wooded grounds designed for patrol-method overnight and day outings.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Simon Kenton Council camp page. The source labeled this a Muskingum Valley Council camp, which is incorrect: it is a current Simon Kenton Council primitive-camping property. Coordinates geocoded via US Census (the source's coordinates were mislocated); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, correct Simon Kenton Council operation, and active status verified; source council corrected from Muskingum Valley; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively; features unsurveyed.
